mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM label_project WHERE deleted = 0) AS projectCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM label_project WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'running') AS runningProjectCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM label_asset WHERE deleted = 0) AS assetCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(completed_count), 0) FROM label_task WHERE deleted = 0) AS completedAssetCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM label_job WHERE deleted = 0) AS jobCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM label_job WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'pending_review') AS pendingReviewCount, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN asset_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE completed_count * 100 / asset_count END)), 0) FROM label_task WHERE deleted = 0) AS completionRate, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(pass_rate)), 0) FROM label_qc_report WHERE deleted = 0) AS qualityRate

SELECT t.task_no AS taskNo, t.task_name AS taskName, p.project_name AS projectName, t.asset_count AS assetCount, t.completed_count AS completedCount, CASE WHEN t.asset_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(t.completed_count * 100 / t.asset_count) END AS progress FROM label_task t JOIN label_project p ON p.id = t.project_id WHERE t.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.update_time DESC, t.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.status = '0'

SELECT u.nick_name AS name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN j.assignee_id = u.user_id THEN j.asset_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN j.assignee_id = u.user_id AND DATE(j.update_time) = CURRENT_DATE() THEN j.asset_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN j.assignee_id = u.user_id AND YEARWEEK(j.update_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURRENT_DATE(), 1) THEN j.asset_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS week, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN j.reviewer_id = u.user_id THEN j.asset_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS review, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM label_annotation_object ao JOIN label_annotation a ON a.id = ao.annotation_id AND a.deleted = 0 JOIN label_job jb ON jb.id = a.job_id AND jb.deleted = 0 WHERE jb.assignee_id = u.user_id AND ao.deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$.kind')), ao.object_type) IN ('bbox', 'rect', 'cuboid')) AS boxCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM label_annotation_object ao JOIN label_annotation a ON a.id = ao.annotation_id AND a.deleted = 0 JOIN label_job jb ON jb.id = a.job_id AND jb.deleted = 0 WHERE jb.assignee_id = u.user_id AND ao.deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$.kind')), ao.object_type) IN ('point', 'keypoint')) AS pointCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ja.asset_id) FROM label_job_asset ja JOIN label_job jb ON jb.id = ja.job_id AND jb.deleted = 0 WHERE jb.assignee_id = u.user_id) AS frameCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ast.entry_id) FROM label_job_asset ja JOIN label_job jb ON jb.id = ja.job_id AND jb.deleted = 0 JOIN label_asset ast ON ast.id = ja.asset_id AND ast.deleted = 0 WHERE jb.assignee_id = u.user_id AND ast.entry_id IS NOT NULL) AS entryCount FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN label_job j ON j.deleted = 0 AND (j.assignee_id = u.user_id OR j.reviewer_id = u.user_id) WHERE u.status = '0' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.nick_name ORDER BY total DESC, review DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM label_entry_node n JOIN label_data_entry e ON e.id = n.entry_id AND e.deleted = 0 JOIN label_task t ON t.id = n.task_id AND t.deleted = 0 JOIN label_project p ON p.id = t.project_id AND p.deleted = 0
n.deleted = 0 AND n.task_id = #{taskId} AND e.batch_id = #{batchId} AND n.operator_id IS NOT NULL
AND n.status IN #{s}
AND (e.entry_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.entry_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.task_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
